title: Crossref Hormuz pubs spike leads Brent up (reversal)
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Reversal of R2-0016: Crossref weekly Hormuz publication spikes coincide with rising, not falling, Brent; z-score > 1 leads BZ=F up by 1 week (+); trade long BZ=F 5d [research.hormuz.crossref_pubs -> finance.BZ=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0016)
message: Weak positive contemporaneous r=0.10 (n=81, perm_p=0.25): Hormuz pub spikes coincide with slightly rising Brent, not falling; lead at 1 week not significant. Trade: long BZ=F 1d, 7 trades, hit 57%, sharpe-like 1.08, actionability 5.19.

trade_idea.entry_rule: research.hormuz.crossref_pubs rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long BZ=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Null control for R2-0114: Crossref weekly Hormuz publication share (not raw counts) shows no lead on Brent; z-score > 1 fails to predict BZ=F log return at lag 1 week [research.hormuz.crossref_share -> finance.BZ=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0114)
